standing: three-task exploratory bakeoff, Mind vs Hermes only; NOT a superiority claim under competitive benchmark v1 (24 paired trials)
host: everything runs on the staging box 192.168.4.95 (Debian 13, 8 cores, 12 GB): both legs and all artifact execution — one host, no environment confound; wall time recorded per leg but still not treated as a performance ranking

containment.network: net/cb2net.sh — Docker network cb2net 172.30.0.0/24; iptables DOCKER-USER: ACCEPT established/related to the subnet, ACCEPT subnet → 192.168.4.203 tcp/443 (the owned model gateway), DROP everything else from the subnet; containers run with --dns 127.0.0.1 and --add-host aig.mycluster.cyou:192.168.4.203; the script ends with a probe container that must print 'gateway ok / internet blocked / dns blocked'
containment.filesystem: Hermes: image cb2-hermes (docker/hermes.Dockerfile), --read-only root, tmpfs /tmp 512m, only two writable mounts: the task directory (/work) and a fresh per-task HERMES_HOME; unprivileged uid 10001; --memory 4g --cpus 4 --pids-limit 512. Checks: image cb2-check (docker/check.Dockerfile), a writable COPY of the artifact at /work, --memory 2g --cpus 2 --pids-limit 256, 300 s. The Mind's page path executes nothing; its artifacts are executed only inside cb2-check.
containment.mind: a fresh scratch instance per task on the host (run/scratch_up.sh: /var/lib/ym-cb2, ports 8099/8091/8078, YM_LOCAL_OLLAMA_URL=the gateway, model qwen3.8:27b-q4_K_M, YM_PRIVATE_PROVIDERS=YM_HOUSEHOLD_PROVIDERS=ollama-local, no cloud keys, no Telegram, no coder, DMN/proactive/patterns/home-watch off); torn down after each task with a receipt (run/scratch_down.sh)

mind.binary: the deployed staging mind-core, ledger tip at run time (provenance in the receipt)
mind.invocation: one POST /api/agent {name, task} through the paired scratch console; the delegate router chooses the executor
mind.known_limit: no code executor on this binary: a brief routed to `code` reads 'not runnable as configured'

hermes.config: model.default qwen3.8:27b-q4_K_M, provider custom, base_url https://aig.mycluster.cyou/v1, agent.max_turns 8
hermes.invocation: one `hermes chat -Q -t file,terminal,code_execution -q "Work only inside the current directory (/work). <brief>"` per task, cwd /work (fresh, empty)

model.rule: the only model either system can reach — enforced by the network, not by configuration alone

caps.enforcement: Hermes: agent.max_turns=8 prevents a 9th request; the receipt counts `API call #n` lines for the session and fails closed (invalid) if the session id or log is missing. Mind: the harness reads the scratch instance's inference_call rows under the closed schema (v1, verdict served|failed|refused, attempts:<n>; anything else counted as malformed, never as spend) every 15 s and KILLS the instance on the 9th request or at 1800 s (status cancelled:cap|cancelled:timeout).
caps.manual_edits: none — artifact directories are made read-only at exit/done and tree-hashed immediately
caps.downloads_installs: forbidden and impossible by network; any transcript line matching pip/npm/apt/curl/wget disqualifies anyway
caps.artifact_execution: only inside cb2-check on a writable copy

briefs.contracts: vendor-neutral store/render/CLI contracts appended to each brief (identical text to both systems)

seed.semantics: 20 leads, UTC calendar days, 14 bins ending on the UTC date of the newest lead (2026-09-02) inclusive, every bin present; recent = 5 names newest first
seed.placement: the T1 checker writes the seed to data/leads.json in the writable copy before the dashboard check; the form check runs on the seed too (expects exactly total+1 afterwards)

checks.image: cb2-check: Playwright 1.62.1 chromium, viewport 1280x800, 10 s load, console errors and any non-loopback request captured; pytest 8.3.5
checks.T1: checks/check_web.mjs t1 — run.sh present; site up on 8123; loads with 0 console errors and 0 external requests; relative links resolve; form#cb2-lead-form present; submit appends EXACTLY one record; the record equals the submitted fields with exactly the six contract keys and an ISO-8601 UTC created_at; /dashboard embeds script#cb2-dashboard whose total, per_day (14 exact keys and counts) and recent (5 names, order) equal seed/expected.json
checks.T2: checks/check_web.mjs t2 — loads with 0 console errors and 0 external requests; relative links resolve; section#projects has ≥4 article; section#writing has ≥3 article; section#contact has a mailto: link or a form
checks.T3: checks/check_t3.py — tracker.py present; test_*.py present and `python -m pytest -q` passes; on a fresh store: add→'added #1', add→'added #2', list = two exact lines, done 1→'done #1', list shows [x], today = the open task added today, tasks.json is a two-item array; every command its own process
checks.selftest: selftest/selftest.sh — six fixtures (t1/t2/t3 × pass/fail) must yield the expected verdicts before any graded run; the run's output is sent to the reviewer

output_dir_contract.mind: RESULT.md (the job's result text, the declared output) plus every file the job added under the scratch YM_WEB_DIR
output_dir_contract.tree_hash: tools/tree_hash.py — SHA-256 over sorted (relative path, bytes); excludes .git, __pycache__, node_modules, .pytest_cache, .venv, *.pyc, .DS_Store, Thumbs.db

receipts: counts, ids, hashes, timings and statuses only; never result text (RESULT.md lives in the artifact)

cost.mind: requests and attempts from the closed-schema rows; tokens absent
cost.hermes: API calls and provider-reported in/out tokens from its session log
cost.comparable: requests/attempts; tokens reported for Hermes with the mind's stated absent; wall recorded, not ranked

viewer_test: Pranab, blind: per task the two artifacts as A/B (map held by Codex outside the repo), fifteen seconds each, a forced pick; unsealed only after the pick is on the ledger
kill: a label unsealed before the pick
a check softened after a failure
a run on the live mind.db
any run that reached the internet or installed anything
any run over 8 model requests or 1800 s
a self-test that disagrees with its expected verdict at run time
